SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
Date January 26, 1939.
Subject Japanese Real Estate Owners movements on the Municipal Land Tax.
Made by D.S. Kamashita Forwarded by C Crawford

With reference to the attached cutting from the
North China Daily News and translation from the Shanghai
Mainichi regarding the attitude of local Japanese real
estate owners towards the Municipal land tax, I have
to state that as reported in the newspapers, committee
members of the Japanese Real Estate Owners' League in
Shanghai, which has some forty members, held a meeting
at the Japanese Club, Boone Road between 6 p.m. and 9 p.m.
on January 14 with a view to discussing the matter of land
tax required by the Municipal Council.

During the course of the meeting it was decided that
a petition be made to the Municipal Council to cancel the
tax on land situated in the Settlement area North of the
Soochow Creek for that period between August and December,
1937. As was done with the house tax in the same area.
Another decision arrived at was that a petition be made to
the Municipal authorities to effect a re-assessment of
the land values. The present Municipal rate on land is
levied on the basis of assessment which was instituted
several years ago, while the conditions have changed
greatly as a result of the recent hostilities. It is their
opinion that the land values should be reassessed taking
into consideration present circumstances.

These petitions are stated to have been made to
the Municipal Council through Mr. Mizuta, a Japanese member
of the Land Committee of the S.M.C. and he is negotiating
with the authorities.

D.C. (Special Branch).
D. S.
（批：P.A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) 27/1）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.I，特科
报告
日期：1939年1月26日。
主题：日本房地产业主关于工部局地税的动向。
制作人：D.S. Kamashita（山下） 转呈人：C Crawford

鉴于随附的《字林西报》剪报及《上海每日新闻》关于当地日本房地产业主对工部局地税态度的译文，本人须陈述如下：据报纸报道，拥有约四十名成员的上海日本房地产业主联盟委员会成员，于1月14日下午6时至9时在布恩路（Boone Road）日本俱乐部举行会议，旨在讨论工部局所要求的地税事宜。

会议期间决定，向工部局提交请愿书，要求取消苏州河以北租界区域内1937年8月至12月期间的地税，正如对该区域房产税所做的那样。另一项决定是，向市政当局提交请愿书，要求对土地价值进行重新评估。目前的工部局地税是基于几年前制定的评估标准征收的，而由于最近的战事，情况已发生巨大变化。他们的意见是，应结合当前情况重新评估土地价值。

据悉，这些请愿书已通过工部局土地委员会日籍委员水田（Mizuta）先生提交给工部局，他正与当局进行谈判。

D.C.（特科）。
D. S.
（批注：P.A. 致 D. C. (特科) 1月27日）

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

JAN 1 6 1939

Japanese Seek Tax
Moratorium

Cry Revived to Lift Burden
Of S.M.C. Land Charges

Reviving a cry of a year ago in
revised form, Japanese property
owners on Saturday launched a cam-
paign for a moratorium on the pay-
ment of land taxes to the Shanghai
Municipal Council for a period up
from Jan. 1, 1938 to June 30, 1941,
the Shanghai "Mainichi" revealed
yesterday.

Also advocated at a three-hour
meeting of the Shanghai Japanese
Real Estate Owners' League on
Saturday, the daily said, was the re-
assessment of land values owned by
Japanese. The present rates, it was
said, were imposed in 1936 on the
basis of a survey dating as far back
as 1933.

Originally, the Japanese Real
Estate Owners' League last January
advocated the non-payment of land
taxes, but the movement failed be-
cause by the time the action was
proposed some of the landowners had
already paid their rates, the
"Mainichi" stated. In normal con-
ditions, Japanese paid $350,000 a year
to the Council in land taxes alone,
the newspaper reported.

Admitting that the realization of
the landowners' demands would bring
but little economic advantages here,
the Japanese daily said that the suc-
cess of the negotiations would bring
a favourable reaction in Japan pro-
per.

Claims for consideration by the
Council are based upon the "new
circumstances" which have taken
place here as a result of the "valuable
sacrifices of the Japanese Army and
Navy," according to the "Mainichi."

S.I.
Yamashita

D.S. Yamashita

《字林西报》。

1939年1月16日

日本人寻求税收
暂缓期

呼声再起，旨在减轻
工部局地税负担

《上海每日新闻》昨日披露，日本房地产业主于周六发起了一场运动，以修订后的形式重提一年前的呼声，要求暂缓向上海公共租界工部局缴纳1938年1月1日至1941年6月30日期间的地税。

该日报称，在周六举行的为期三小时的上海日本房地产业主联盟会议上，还主张对日籍人士拥有的土地价值进行重新评估。据说，目前的税率是1936年实施的，依据的是早在1933年进行的调查。

《每日新闻》称，最初，日本房地产业主联盟在去年一月主张不缴纳地税，但该运动未能成功，因为当提出该行动时，部分业主已经缴纳了税款。该报报道，在正常条件下，日本人每年仅向工部局缴纳的地税就达35万美元。

该日文报纸承认，实现业主的要求在此地带来的经济利益微乎其微，但表示谈判的成功将在日本本土带来有利的反响。

据《每日新闻》称，提请工部局考虑的理由是基于因“日本陆海军的宝贵牺牲”而在此地发生的“新情况”。

S.I.
Yamashita（山下）
2/3
D.S. Yamashita（山下）

MAINICHI

JAPANESE MOVEMENT TO POSTPONE PAYMENT OF LAND
TAX AND TO REVISE THE MUNICIPAL RATES

At 6 p.m. January 14 the directors
of the United Association of Estate Owners in Shanghai
held a meeting at the Japanese Club. Among those present
were Mr. Hayashi, Chairman of the Association and Messrs
Shimosato, Takematsu, Honda, Orida, Ashizawa, Makise and
Ohta.

The meeting resolved (1) that
payment of land tax be postponed and (2) that a request
be made for the revision of the Municipal rates.
The meeting also discussed
the policy to be adopted in these matters.

Japanese who own land on the
north side of the Soochow Creek pay a land tax of Yen300,000
to the S.M.C. every year. In January, 1938 the land-
owners asked the S.M.C. for exemption from the land
tax, but the S.M.C. could not agree because a section of
the owners had already paid their tax. The Japanese
landowners have now resolved to submit another proposal
to the effect that the payment of their land tax be postponed
for three years( namely to June 30, 1941).

It was also resolved that the
S.M.C. be requested to revise the Municipal rate which
were made in 1936 on the basis of the investigation made
in 1933.

In connection with the land
tax question, Consul-General Miura has been requested
to do his best to give effect to the resolution because
it would affect Japanese interests greatly. As regards
the standard of land tax Mr. Mizuda, a Japanese member of
the Land Commission of the S.M.C. will be requested to
do his best in the interests of Japanese.

D.S. Tanaka
R.Y

《每日新闻》

日本方面推迟缴纳地税及修订工部局税率的动向

1月14日下午6时，上海房地产业主联合协会董事在日本俱乐部举行会议。出席者包括协会主席林（Hayashi）先生，以及下里（Shimosato）、竹松（Takematsu）、本田（Honda）、织田（Orida）、芦泽（Ashizawa）、牧濑（Makise）和大田（Ohta）等先生。

会议决议：(1) 推迟缴纳地税；(2) 请求修订工部局税率。
会议还讨论了在这些事项上应采取的政策。

拥有苏州河北岸土地的日本人每年向工部局缴纳30万日元的地税。1938年1月，土地业主曾请求工部局免除地税，但工部局未能同意，因为部分业主已经缴纳税款。日本土地业主现在决定提交另一项提案，即将其地税缴纳推迟三年（即至1941年6月30日）。

会议还决议，请求工部局修订其税率，该税率是1936年根据1933年的调查制定的。

关于地税问题，已请求三浦（Miura）总领事尽力落实该决议，因为它将极大地影响日本利益。至于地税标准，将请求工部局土地委员会日籍委员水田（Mizuda）先生为日本利益尽力而为。

D.S. Tanaka（田中）
R.Y
